_purpose: Drives the generic company-profile / company-productions / company-tour templates added by the visiting-company-templates task. Nothing here is Lovett-specific engine code - any future touring company ships the same shape.
_copy_status: DRAFT pending Jamie Firth's approval. All facts are from boondogtheatre.com and the Criterion event page - Boondog's own published material.
name: BoonDog Theatre
tagline: Covertly political stories, hidden in the past.
body: Founded in 2012 by Lucy Roslyn and Jamie Firth. Intimate, character-driven work - almost always darkly comic, always aiming for the heart, and what they describe as "covertly political". Backed by a passion for detailed research.
footline: Associate Artists of the Royal & Derngate, Northampton

_productions_note: Six posters, deliberately ORDERED for a 2x3 split: items 0-2 (Orlando, State Vs John Hayes, Pennyroyal) are the awards/London-producer end of their work; items 3-5 (Piskie, Goody, Showmanship) are the Roslyn/Firth two-hander shows closest in shape to Lovett. Lovett itself is excluded - it is tonight's show. Credits transcribed from boondogtheatre.com. Posters are portrait (0.64-0.71) and the gallery frames use object-fit: contain, so nothing is cropped. The 2x3 SPLIT ITSELF needs item.offset/item.limit from docs/cascade-prompts/2026-08-gallery-templates-generic.md; until that lands the playlist shows one six-up gallery, which works but is small across a bar.

good_egg.headline: They also do this
good_egg.body: BoonDog run Fringe Festival Support - a chat show, backed by the Mental Health Foundation, helping Fringe performers and crew look after themselves through the most stressful month of their year.

tour._image_note: BoonDog's own tour poster - approved artwork, no rights question, and it reads as official. Its printed text is far too small at foyer distance, which is why the dates below are re-typeset by the template. Use the poster as the side image, not as the information.

tour._dates_note: Scraped from boondogtheatre.com/lovett on 2026-08-01. Chester is highlighted because it is the very next date after ours - the single cheapest way to make a visiting company feel looked after. Special London shows (TBA) and the tour's 2025 leg are deliberately omitted. Eight is the template cap; seven listed.
